key.name: screensaver-enabled
key.description: Master toggle for idle screensaver activation.

key.name: idle-timeout
key.description: Seconds of inactivity before screensaver triggers.

key.name: test-trigger
key.description: Incremented to immediately trigger screensaver preview.

key.name: inhibit-fullscreen
key.description: Prevent screensaver while watching fullscreen video or gaming.

key.name: lockscreen-enabled
key.description: Show falling digital rain behind the lock screen / shield.

key.name: glyph-set
key.description: Alphabet used for digital code rain (katakana, binary, hex, html, road, ui).

key.name: lead-color
key.description: Hex or rgb color for the glowing leader glyphs.

key.name: trail-color
key.description: Hex or rgb color for the trailing rain glyphs.

key.name: font-size
key.description: Glyph font size in logical pixels.

key.name: row-spacing
key.description: Vertical spacing between characters in stream (percentage).

key.name: glyph-scale
key.description: Percentage of grid cell occupied by symbol.

key.name: glow-enabled
key.description: Enable subpixel bloom glow around glyphs.

key.name: aa-sharpness
key.description: Anti-aliasing edge crispness. Low = soft feathered edges, High = sharp crisp edges.
